text:
NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author swapped the screenshots in the PR description and asked for another look. There was no new push, which is fine because the feedback was only about screenshots.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Before/after images are now the same size (1861×102), so they can be flipped between |
| ❌  | Only one pair, and it doesn't cover the states the description claims: pills wrapping (vertical centering) and long text (the new ellipsis) |
| ❌  | No zoomed-out comparison, which is where the overlap shows up and what the issue asks to be tested |
| ℹ️  | Linked issue has "help wanted" and CI passed, so nothing else blocks this |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask for a fuller set of precise screenshots. This is a layout change from `flex` to `block`, so it needs to show the search bar's other states are unaffected.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the screenshots, @JoeJoeflyn! Could you add before/after pairs of the same size for the other states this change touches: pills that wrap onto multiple lines, long text that now gets an ellipsis, and a zoomed-out view where the caret overlap shows? See the [precise screenshots guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots) for what to cover.
```
